title: Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2611.26856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop self-supervised methods for training Recursive Quadrature Filter (RQF) encoders on unlabeled time series. RQFs are biologically motivated, complex-valued temporal filters that form a special class of diagonal state-space models (SSMs). Each RQF acts as a band-pass filter whose selectivity is determined by two learnable parameters: its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We separately introduce a self-supervised learning objective based on prediction error; the encoder is trained so that its current state predicts its own future activity. In the windowed mode, the summary of the current window predicts the summary of a later window; in the dense mode, the state at the current timestep predicts future log-power. Each RQF encoder is pretrained on a dataset and then a readout (e.g., a task-specific classifier) is trained on the output of the RQF encoder, with the encoder either frozen or fully fine-tuned. translated_title: 基于递归正交滤波器的神经时间序列自监督学习
translated_abstract: 我们开发了在无标签时间序列上训练递归正交滤波器（RQF）编码器的自监督方法。RQF是一类受生物学启发的复数值时间滤波器，构成对角状态空间模型（SSM）的一个特殊类别。每个RQF作为一个带通滤波器，其选择性由两个可学习参数决定：调谐频率和带宽。我们另外引入了一种基于预测误差的自监督学习目标；编码器经过训练，使其当前状态能够预测自身的未来活动。在窗口模式下，当前窗口的摘要预测后续窗口的摘要；在密集模式下，当前时间步的状态预测未来的对数功率。每个RQF编码器先在数据集上进行预训练，然后在RQF编码器的输出上训练一个读出层（例如任务特定的分类器），此时编码器可以保持冻结或进行完全微调。对于多通道脑电图（EEG）和颅内……
tldr: 本文提出一种自监督学习方法，通过让可学习的递归正交滤波器（一类受生物学启发的对角状态空间带通滤波器）编码器的当前状态预测其自身未来活动，在无标签神经时间序列上预训练编码器，再结合读出层完成下游任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a self-supervised learning method that pretrains biologically motivated Recursive Quadrature Filter encoders—learnable band-pass diagonal state-space models—by predicting their own future activity on unlabeled neural time series, followed by a readout for downstream tasks.
